about: THE KEEPSAKE stage boss: the art contract between kboss-core (the fight and its renderer, src/render/gross/boss/keepsake.ts) and kboss-art (tools/prep_keepsake_boss.py, the PNGs). Each strip is src/sprites/<name>@<frames>.png, frames left to right, equal size (src/sprites.ts loads every PNG there at boot). Boss-local px, y down, from the boss origin (e.x, e.y). Tilt: + rolls the crown AWAY from the ship (right), - TOWARD it (the window). Until a strip exists the renderer draws its greybox (the midboss sprite scaled 2.15x, rotated at runtime, plus procedural overlays). The renderer reads `frame`, `tilts` and each strip's anchor from this file, so a size change here needs no code change; frame ORDER and names are fixed.
status: stub: no PNGs yet (kboss-art delivers them)

keepsake-boss-face.note: the head, pre-rotated per tilt (never rotated at runtime). crack: whole = DOZING, hairline = AWAKE, split = the IT CRACKED transition, open = CRACKED (the split face from the wound down toward the player-side eye; the mechanism and ship meat inside, no bone, no teeth). Eyes and wound are separate overlays: leave the sockets and the soft spot for them

keepsake-boss-eyes.note: full-frame overlays (transparent outside the sockets) so the anchor is the face's. empty = CRACKED's sockets: the eyes are on the rocker now

keepsake-boss-wound.note: full-frame overlays: the fork seated in the soft spot, the fork proud (a tell), the wound gaping (fork out: the boomerang, the open window), the brain exposed (CRACKED)

keepsake-boss-rocker.index: 0 swung toward the ship, 1 hanging, 2 swung away
keepsake-boss-rocker.note: the sleep-eye mechanism: two glass eyes on a bent wire with a lead weight. The anchor is the pivot; the renderer rotates it along the swing (a thin part, not the face). Eyes use the game's wet-eye treatment

keepsake-boss-crier.note: the 'mama' voice box: a perforated tin cylinder with a bellows

keepsake-boss-death.note: PUT TO BED: the head on its side (from the profile photo), eyes shut
